How a project moves

A process that doesn't hide the middle part.

Five stages, repeated every release. Nothing reaches production until it has passed the checks we agreed on together.

01

Discover

We sit with the problem before touching a keyboard — talking to the people who'll use the product.

02

Design

Wireframes and prototypes get tested early, so mistakes are cheap to fix.

03

Build

Short cycles, visible progress, working software every week — not a reveal at the end.

04

Ship

Releases are boring on purpose: staged rollouts, rollback plans, no surprises.

05

Support

We stay on after launch. A product without upkeep is a liability, not an asset.
